Core Structure: 1x3x1 to 5x10x5 cube filled inside Casing

Main Block centered on Side parallel to electrode plate and facing outwards
Energy output at Main Block, input at the opposite face of the Casing

Type of Electrode Part used affects its voltage per block
Longer Core (excludes Electrodes) has greater voltage
